# has sensitivity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSensitivity`](gmeow-hasSensitivity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSensitivity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a value, entity, or claim to its privacy-sensitivity level — the explicit facet that drives disclosure-control decisions ([`coarsenTo`](gmeow-coarsenTo.md) / displayable) at projection time under a consent guard. Domain-free (universal, like [`hasGranularity`](gmeow-hasGranularity.md) and [`hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md)). NOT functional: in a multi-source merge sources may state different sensitivity levels, and those claims coexist rather than force the reasoner to collapse distinct levels. Distinct from [`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md) (epistemic certainty) and from [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md) (ontic model).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; `?` -> [`gmeow:SensitivityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-SensitivityLevel.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasSensitivity`](gmeow-hasSensitivity.md) from `?` to [`gmeow:SensitivityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-SensitivityLevel.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Sensitivity And Disclosure

- **Source:** [`slices/core/kernel/examples/sensitivity-and-disclosure.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/kernel/examples/sensitivity-and-disclosure.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-kernel-examples-sensitivity-and-disclosure)#example-slices-core-kernel-examples-sensitivity-and-disclosure

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: the kernel disclosure machinery (Principles 10 and 12). Any entity can
# declare HOW SENSITIVE it is (gmeow:hasSensitivity), the POLICY governing its
# release (gmeow:hasDisclosurePolicy), and WHICH CONSUMERS are eligible to receive
# it (gmeow:eligibleForConsumer → a ProjectionContext). This is the projection/
# disclosure boundary: a confidential record is never deleted, only withheld from
# the wrong consumer (P10 suppression, P12 solver/presentation split). Part-whole
# mereology (gmeow:partOf / gmeow:hasPart) and gmeow:hasDeterminacy (how crisp the
# value is) are the other kernel primitives every slice reuses.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/kernel/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

# --- A confidential record: sensitive, internal-only, eligible only for the
#     internal archive — withheld from public consumers, not deleted.
ex:salaryRecord a gmeow:InformationObject ;
    rdfs:label                "Compensation record"@en ;
    gmeow:partOf              ex:dossier ;
    gmeow:hasSensitivity      gmeow:sensitivityConfidential ;
    gmeow:hasDisclosurePolicy gmeow:policyInternalOnly ;
    gmeow:eligibleForConsumer gmeow:consumerInternalArchive ;
    gmeow:hasDeterminacy      gmeow:determinacyCrisp .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify how sensitive a value, entity, or claim is, so the projection layer can decide whether to coarsen or withhold it for a given consumer.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for epistemic certainty ([`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md)) or ontic determinacy ([`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md)), and avoid collapsing competing source classifications — keep it non-functional.

### How to use

- Point the value at a [`gmeow:SensitivityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-SensitivityLevel.md); combine with [`gmeow:hasDisclosurePolicy`](gmeow-hasDisclosurePolicy.md) and [`gmeow:coarsenTo`](gmeow-coarsenTo.md) so the solver can resolve the conditional release decision under a consent guard.

### Examples

- ex:homeAddress [`gmeow:hasSensitivity`](gmeow-hasSensitivity.md) [`gmeow:sensitivitySensitivePersonal`](../individuals/gmeow-sensitivitySensitivePersonal.md).
